response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"HTML, paragraph 2 (2 Corinthians 4:8)","severity":"major","source_quote":"we are perplexed, but not in despair","suggested_fix":"Translate “perplexed” as उलझन में हैं, preserving the contrast with “not in despair”; for example: “हम उलझन में तो हैं, पर निराश नहीं होते।”","translation_quote":"निरुपाय तो होते हैं, पर निराश नहीं होते"},{"location":"HTML, paragraph 4 (Romans 10:17)","severity":"major","source_quote":"faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God","suggested_fix":"Replace “मसीह के वचन” with “परमेश्वर के वचन” so the quotation preserves the source’s wording and attribution.","translation_quote":"विश्वास सुनने से, और सुनना मसीह के वचन से होता है"},{"location":"HTML, paragraph 8 (Matthew 10:16)","severity":"major","source_quote":"wise as serpents, and harmless as doves","suggested_fix":"Use a Hindi equivalent of “harmless” such as “हानिरहित” or “निर्दोष”; “भोले” can mean naïve and does not preserve the source’s contrast.","translation_quote":"साँपों के समान बुद्धिमान और कबूतरों के समान भोले बनो"},{"location":"HTML, paragraph 22 (Revelation 22:20-21)","severity":"minor","source_quote":"The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.","suggested_fix":"Include “मसीह” in the title: “हमारे प्रभु यीशु मसीह का अनुग्रह तुम सब पर बना रहे।”","translation_quote":"प्रभु यीशु का अनुग्रह तुम सब पर बना रहे।"}],"passed":false,"score":84}
